optional_tasks.prompt: Escribe un ensayo de opinión (150 a 180 palabras): 'Should schools teach financial education?' Incluye introducción, dos argumentos con ejemplo, un contraargumento con 'Nevertheless', una estructura con 'Not only…' o una condicional de tipo 3 y una conclusión.
self_check_es: ¿Usa Not only… o un condicional tipo 3?
model_answer: In recent years, young people have been exposed to credit cards and online shopping at an ever earlier age. While some argue that money management should be taught at home, I strongly believe that schools should include financial education.

Firstly, not every family has the knowledge to teach it. If students had learnt how interest works, many of them would have avoided serious debt later in life. Secondly, financial education helps young people make informed decisions. Not only does it teach them how to budget, but it also prepares them for the realities of adult life.

On the other hand, critics claim that the curriculum is already overloaded and that teachers lack the training. It is true that time is limited. Nevertheless, a short weekly class would be enough to cover the basics, and specialists could be invited to support teachers.

In conclusion, although parents play an important role, schools are better placed to guarantee that everyone receives this education. I therefore believe that it should be part of the standard curriculum.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
